units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:10">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>אם יאמר … ש׳ הוא</he> if one tells thee, the morning star is the same as the morning dawn (<cite ref="A01316"><he>אַיַּילְתָּא</he></cite>), he is a liar.
